example: It's reported that negotiations have reached a stalemate.
example_zh: 據報導談判陷入了僵局。
memory_hint: stalemate 可表示僵局，也可作動詞表示使陷入僵局；三態 stalemate, stalemated, stalemated。

example: Please think it over and don't be stampeded into buying the house.
example_zh: 請想清楚了，不要一時衝動買下這棟房子。
memory_hint: stampede 可指驚逃、蜂擁，也可作動詞表示迫使匆忙行動；三態 stampede, stampeded, stampeded。

example: In fact, some people are after wealth and status.
example_zh: 事實上，有些人追求財富和地位。
memory_hint: status 指地位、身分或狀況。

example: Generally speaking, some children are fond of the sticks of candy. We stuck the posters all over the walls.
example_zh: 一般而言，有些孩子喜歡棒棒糖。我們把海報貼得滿牆都是。
memory_hint: stick 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 stick, stuck, stuck。

example: It's said that the book is out of stock. This shop stocks all sizes.
example_zh: 據說該書已無庫存。這家商店備有各種尺碼。
memory_hint: stock 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 stock, stocked, stocked。

example: Generally speaking, the clouds threatened a big storm. "Get out of here!" she stormed, for her son's talking back.
example_zh: 一般而言，烏雲表示暴風雨即將來臨。她因兒子頂嘴而對他大發脾氣道：「滾出去！」
chinese: 暴風雨；激動；爆發；猛攻；怒罵；起風暴
memory_hint: storm 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 storm, stormed, stormed。

example: The hooligan strangled the old woman with a piece of string.
example_zh: 那流氓用一根繩子把老婦人勒死了。
memory_hint: strangle 表勒死、使窒息；三態 strangle, strangled, strangled。

example: There are four strings on a violin. Lanterns were strung in the trees around the west lake.
example_zh: 小提琴有四根弦。西湖周圍的樹上懸掛著燈籠。
memory_hint: string 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 string, strung, strung。

example: Rose says her former company is very stultifying.
example_zh: 蘿絲說她以前的公司極其單調乏味。
chinese: 極其單調乏味的；使人變遲鈍的
memory_hint: stultifying 指使人覺得沉悶、遲鈍的。

example: One of Mr. Miller's friends is a bricklaying subcontractor.
example_zh: 米勒先生的一位朋友是砌磚轉包商。
memory_hint: sub + contractor，指承接主承包商部分工作的次承包商。

example: Roy was subpoenaed as a witness yesterday.
example_zh: 羅伊昨天作為證人被傳喚。
memory_hint: subpoena 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 subpoena, subpoenaed, subpoenaed。

example: Jenny's house is insured against subsidence.
example_zh: 珍妮家的房子投了房子下沉險。
memory_hint: subsidence 指下沉、沉降。

example: The old people will suffer worst if housing subsidies are cut.
example_zh: 如果削減住房津貼，最吃苦頭的就是那些老人。
memory_hint: subsidy 指政府或機構提供的補助金、津貼。

example: Joanna has learnt to suffer without complaining.
example_zh: 喬安娜已經學會吃苦而不抱怨。
memory_hint: suffer 表遭受、忍受；常接 pain, loss 等。

example: Turner's former boss attempted suicide after his firm had gone bankrupt.
example_zh: 特納的前任老闆在公司破產後試圖自殺。
memory_hint: suicide 指自殺或自殺行為。

example: Jane helped one of her friends supervise the whole department.
example_zh: 珍幫助她的一個朋友管理這個部門。
memory_hint: supervise 表監督、管理；三態 supervise, supervised, supervised。

example: Generally speaking, each nation suppresses news that is not favorable to it.
example_zh: 一般而言，每個國家都封鎖對它不利的消息。
memory_hint: suppress 表壓制、鎮壓或禁止；三態 suppress, suppressed, suppressed。

example: It's said that there may be a 10% surcharge on airline tickets.
example_zh: 據說飛機票可能增收百分之十附加費。
memory_hint: surcharge 可作名詞表示附加費，也可作動詞表示加收費用；三態 surcharge, surcharged, surcharged。

example: The young surgeon built himself a new surgery.
example_zh: 那位年輕的外科醫生為自己建了一間新的外科手術室。
memory_hint: surgeon 指外科醫師；複數 surgeons。

example: The famous surgeon is preparing for the surgery.
example_zh: 那個著名的外科醫生正在做手術前的準備。
memory_hint: surgery 可指外科醫學、外科手術或診療室。

example: Generally speaking, Mexico has a surplus of oil.
example_zh: 一般而言，墨西哥有過剩的石油。
memory_hint: surplus 指超出需要的剩餘量。

example: We think animals in zoos are not in their natural surroundings.
example_zh: 我們認為動物園裡的動物不是生活在自然環境中。
memory_hint: surroundings 常用複數，表示周圍環境。

example: For each of us, survival is our first imperative.
example_zh: 對我們每一個人來說，首要任務是設法生存下來。
memory_hint: survival 指生存、存活。

example: In our new house, My father suspended the lamp from the ceiling.
example_zh: 我爸爸把燈吊在新房子的天花板上。
memory_hint: suspend 可指懸掛，也可指暫停、取消。

example: Generally speaking, the sea wall must sustain the shock of waves.
example_zh: 一般而言，海堤要承受海浪的衝擊。
memory_hint: sustain 指承受、支撐或維持。

example: Generally speaking, before giving evidence you have to swear an oath.
example_zh: 一般而言，在作證之前你得先宣誓。
memory_hint: swear 為不規則動詞：swear, swore, sworn。

example: Hill sympathized with Joan in her grief.
example_zh: 希爾對瓊的遭遇表示同情。
memory_hint: sympathize with 表同情、體諒某人。

example: The company reported a syndicate of local businessmen is bidding for the contract.
example_zh: 據報導，一個當地企業家的聯合體在同這一合同投標。
memory_hint: syndicate 指企業聯合、財團；複數 syndicates。

example: The tabloid is full of short articles about politics and celebrities.
example_zh: 這一小報盡是些以聳動報導為特點的短小報導。
memory_hint: tabloid 指版面較小、內容精簡或偏聳動的小報。

example: The government lowered the tariff on imported cars.
example_zh: 政府降低了進口汽車的關稅。
memory_hint: tariff 指進出口商品所課徵的關稅。

example: Don't tarry on the road.
example_zh: 不要在路上耽擱。
memory_hint: tarry 表停留、耽擱；三態 tarry, tarried, tarried。

example: When she heard the news, the hot tears welled up in her eyes. Please tear a page out of your notebook if convenient.
example_zh: 當她聽到這個消息，熱淚湧上她的眼睛。如果方便，請從你的筆記本上撕下一頁。
memory_hint: tear 可作名詞或動詞；表示撕裂時三態 tear, tore, torn。

example: The telecommunication service is a government monopoly in China.
example_zh: 中國的電訊通信服務是政府壟斷。
memory_hint: telecommunication 指電信、遠距通信。

example: John believes in temperance in all things.
example_zh: 約翰凡事都重視適度。
memory_hint: temperance 指節制、克制或戒酒。

example: Generally speaking, such tendentious statements are likely to provoke strong opposition.
example_zh: 一般而言，這種有偏向的說法可能招致強烈反對。
memory_hint: tendentious 指帶有明顯傾向或偏見的。

example: The excellence of Shakespeare's plays testifies to his genius.
example_zh: 莎士比亞戲劇的卓越證明了他的天才。
memory_hint: testify to 表證明、證實；testify 也可指作證。

example: It is said that Darwin spent more than twenty years working on his theory of evolution.
example_zh: 據說達爾文花了二十餘年時間研究他的進化論。
memory_hint: theory 指理論、學說；複數 theories。

example: Generally speaking, dark skies threaten rain.
example_zh: 一般而言，烏雲預示著要下雨。
memory_hint: threaten 表威脅，也可指預示不利情況。

example: I often have a sore throat when getting a cold.
example_zh: 我得感冒時常有喉嚨痛。
memory_hint: throat 指喉嚨；sore throat 指喉嚨痛。

example: It is said that some plants are tolerant of extreme heat.
example_zh: 據說有些植物耐得住極端的熱。
memory_hint: tolerant of 表能忍受、容忍。

example: Last night the chimney toppled over on the roof.
example_zh: 昨晚煙囪倒在屋頂上。
memory_hint: topple over 表倒下、傾覆；三態 topple, toppled, toppled。

example: Almost all governments adopt totalitarian measures in time of war.
example_zh: 幾乎所有的政府在戰時都採取極權措施。
memory_hint: totalitarian 指極權主義的。

example: It's much easier to get into towering debt than to get out of debt.
example_zh: 深陷債務容易，但擺脫債務困難。
memory_hint: towering 表高聳、巨大的，towering debt 指高額或沉重債務。

example: The trade balance last year showed a deficit of a billion dollars.
example_zh: 去年的貿易赤字為十億美元。
memory_hint: trade balance 指一國出口與進口金額的差額。

example: Please notice the trademark on the cup.
example_zh: 請注意杯子上的商標。
memory_hint: trademark 指商標、註冊標記。

example: Generally speaking, the company has transferred to the Shanghai office.
example_zh: 一般而言，公司已轉移到上海辦公室。
memory_hint: transfer 表轉移、轉讓；動詞三態 transfer, transferred, transferred。

example: This novel has been translated into twenty languages.
example_zh: 這本小說已被譯成二十種語言。
memory_hint: translate into 表翻譯成某種語言。

example: It's said that Laura had a bone-marrow transplant.
example_zh: 據說蘿拉接受了骨髓移植手術。
memory_hint: transplant 可作名詞或動詞，表示移植；也可指移居。

example: Barbara never recovered from the trauma of her son's death.
example_zh: 芭芭拉再沒有從她兒子去世的精神創傷中恢復過來。
memory_hint: trauma 指身體外傷或心理創傷；複數 traumas。

example: Please follow the treatment with plenty of rest in bed.
example_zh: 請在治療之後好好躺在床上休息。
memory_hint: treatment 可指治療、處理或待遇。

example: The bride spoke her vows with tremulous modesty.
example_zh: 新娘羞澀地以顫抖的聲音發誓。
memory_hint: tremulous 指因緊張或激動而顫抖的。

example: Jill took aim and squeezed the trigger. Generally speaking, a spark can trigger an explosion.
example_zh: 吉爾瞄準目標，然後扣了扳機。一般而言，火花能引起一場爆炸。
memory_hint: trigger 可作名詞或動詞；三態 trigger, triggered, triggered。

example: Our friends find Daniel truculent and unpleasant.
example_zh: 我們的朋友發現丹尼爾既粗野又令人討厭。
memory_hint: truculent 的名詞為 truculency，副詞為 truculently。

example: He was lucky to have drawn a trump. What are you waiting for? Trump now.
example_zh: 他運氣好，抽到王牌。你還等什麼？出王牌吧！
chinese: 王牌；法寶；打出王牌；吹喇叭；勝過
memory_hint: trump 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 trump, trumped, trumped。

example: Generally speaking, a person out of tune with his surroundings is unhappy. The orchestra tuned their instruments before they started playing.
example_zh: 一般而言，一個與環境不和諧的人是不會快樂的。樂隊演奏前先將樂器調音。
chinese: 歌曲；旋律；心情；和諧；調節；和諧
memory_hint: tune 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 tune, tuned, tuned。

example: The disadvantage of the turbine is that it is not reversible.
example_zh: 渦輪機的一個缺點就是它不可以反轉。
memory_hint: turbine 指渦輪機。

example: Generally speaking, girls easily get cheerful and depressed by turns. The earth turns round the sun.
example_zh: 一般而言，女孩子的情緒容易高一陣低一陣地交替。地球繞日運行。
chinese: 轉動；輪班；傾向；翻轉；扭轉；使變成
memory_hint: turn 可作名詞或動詞；動詞三態 turn, turned, turned。

example: People have never forgot the tyrannies of his reign.
example_zh: 人們不會忘記他統治期間的暴政。
memory_hint: tyranny 指暴政、專制統治；複數 tyrannies。

example: Today my mouth has an ulcer.
example_zh: 今天我的口腔出現了潰瘍。
memory_hint: ulcer 的名詞複數為 ulcers。

example: At this meeting Brown was elected by a unanimous vote.
example_zh: 這次會議布朗以全票當選。
memory_hint: unanimous 的副詞是 unanimously，名詞是 unanimousness。

example: It's said that online bookstores can undercut retailers by up to 30%.
example_zh: 據說線上書店能夠比零售商廉價百分之三十出售書本。
memory_hint: undercut 為不規則動詞：undercut, undercut, undercut。

example: To say the new program was bad is an understatement.
example_zh: 說那個新節目不好是保守的說法。
chinese: 含蓄的陳述；保守的說法
memory_hint: under + statement，表示說得比實際情況輕，引申為保守、含蓄的陳述。

example: We happily saw a new road that undulates through pleasant scenery.
example_zh: 我們很高興地看到那條新道路在宜人的景色中延綿起伏。
memory_hint: undulate 表波動、起伏；三態 undulate, undulated, undulated。

example: As recently there is so much unemployment, the competition for jobs is fierce.
example_zh: 因為最近失業嚴重，求職的競爭變得十分激烈。
memory_hint: un + employment，表示沒有就業、失業。

example: We hope that all the nationalities live together in perfect union.
example_zh: 我們希望各族人民非常和睦地生活在一起。
memory_hint: union 可指聯盟、結合，也可指和諧一致。

example: It's reported that our country is experiencing unemployment on an unprecedented scale.
example_zh: 據報導我們國家現在正經歷規模空前的失業情況。
memory_hint: unprecedented 表前所未有、空前的。

example: Laura's manager upbraided her for being late.
example_zh: 蘿拉的經理因她遲到而斥責她。
memory_hint: upbraid 表斥責、責罵；三態 upbraid, upbraided, upbraided。

example: It's said that this part of town is where the upper class lives.
example_zh: 據說鎮上這個地區是上流階級的人住的。
memory_hint: upper class 指社會中的上層階級。

example: That urban renewal project almost has been completed.
example_zh: 那個都市環境改造工程幾近完工。
chinese: 都市環境改造；城市更新
memory_hint: urban 表都市的，renewal 表更新，合起來即城市更新。

example: Sir Thomas More is remembered as the author of Utopia.
example_zh: 湯瑪斯．莫爾爵士因是《烏托邦》的作者而留在人們的記憶之中。
memory_hint: utopia 指理想中的最美好社會；名詞複數為 utopias。

example: Tom had a vaccination against rabies yesterday.
example_zh: 昨天湯姆接種抗狂犬病疫苗。
memory_hint: vaccination 的名詞複數為 vaccinations。

example: I asked the porter to turn off the vacuum.
example_zh: 我請清潔工關掉真空吸塵器。
memory_hint: vacuum 可指真空，也可指真空吸塵器。

example: It's predicted that the value of the dollar may fall. My girlfriend values honesty beyond all things.
example_zh: 美元的幣值預計可能下降。我女友重視誠實勝過一切。
chinese: 價值；重要性；評價；估價；尊重
memory_hint: value 可作名詞表示價值、重要性，也可作動詞表示重視、估價。

example: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.
example_zh: 雲是天空中的水氣團。
memory_hint: vapor 的名詞複數為 vapors。

example: Rose vehemently denies that she ever met Mr. Smith.
example_zh: 蘿絲強烈地否認她曾見過史密斯先生。
memory_hint: vehemently 為副詞，形容詞是 vehement，名詞是 vehemence。

example: My hopes have to rest upon this venture. John is in a temper now so that no one ventures to speak to him.
example_zh: 我不得不把希望寄託在這次冒險上。約翰現在發脾氣以致無人敢跟他講話。
chinese: 冒險；風險；敢嘗試；冒險一試
memory_hint: venture 可作名詞或動詞；三態 venture, ventured, ventured，名詞複數 ventures。

example: Generally speaking, the ground vibrates during the earthquake.
example_zh: 一般而言，地震時地面會震動。
memory_hint: vibrate 表振動、搖擺；三態 vibrate, vibrated, vibrated。

example: Bob's cats are victims of overfeeding.
example_zh: 鮑勃的貓是餵食過量的受害者。
memory_hint: victim 的名詞複數為 victims。

example: Joanna has been vilified by her opponents in the press.
example_zh: 瓊安娜被她的對手在報紙上中傷。
memory_hint: vilify 表誹謗、中傷；三態 vilify, vilified, vilified。

example: Every citizen commits not to violate the law.
example_zh: 每位公民承諾不違反法律。
memory_hint: violate 表違反、侵犯；三態 violate, violated, violated。

example: Please watch of your computer viruses.
example_zh: 請小心電腦病毒。
memory_hint: virus 的名詞複數為 viruses；常見搭配有 influenza virus、intestinal virus。

example: Fiona is a beautiful and vivacious girl.
example_zh: 菲奧娜是位活潑又美麗的女孩。
memory_hint: vivacious 表活潑、有生氣的。

example: The function of the transformers is to change electric power from one voltage to another.
example_zh: 變壓器的功用就是把電力從一種電壓改變為另一種電壓。
memory_hint: voltage 的名詞複數為 voltages；常見搭配 high voltage、low voltage。
